interpretation.ci_below_zero: resolved lower measured attenuation after focal loss with alternative-seagrass occupancy retained
interpretation.ci_above_zero: resolved higher measured attenuation after focal loss with alternative-seagrass occupancy retained
interpretation.ci_overlaps_zero: unresolved physical-function difference; NOT evidence of equivalence
interpretation.below_replication_gate: pilot only; cannot support a decisive null or functional redundancy

secondary: Structure-adjusted state coefficient using total vegetated cover and canopy height; mechanism decomposition only.
no_rescue: Do not change state definitions, pair-selection rule, 100 m limit, valid-day rule, bootstrap or seed after velocity outcomes.
Do not replace the >=3-year persistent-Thalassia comparator with a shorter-history comparator after velocity outcomes.
Do not infer functional equivalence from a non-significant difference.
Do not use Lower/Boca observations to rescue the Old+Middle confirmatory test.
Do not use this branch to rescue an unsupported TNC state-augmentation primary.
